title.en: An Act Declaring August Nineteen of Each Year a Special Working Holiday Throughout the Entire Philippines and a Special Non-working Public Holiday in the Provinces of Quezon and Aurora and Quezon City, to Commemorate the Birth Anniversary of Former President Manuel L. Quezon

text.en: In order to commemorate the birth anniversary of former President Manuel L. Quezon, August Nineteen of each year is hereby declared as a special working holiday throughout the entire Philippines with the exception of the Provinces of Quezon and Aurora and Quezon City where it shall be a non-working holiday.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in at least two (2) newspapers of general circulation.
